text:
carmen: heads-up: sudden uptick in metadata write retries on sa-south1 NVMe cohort, started ~6m ago. GPU attach p95 climbing.
diego: which nodes?
carmen: gnode-801/807/816 showing remap growth & EIOs. dmesg snippet: 
```
[  4590.123456] nvme0: remap table grow 1024->8192 meta_sync=EIO
[  4590.125678] nvme0: metadata write failed, retries=4
[  4591.000001] block: writeback stall detected
```
mike: did we schedule any cleaners/compactors recently in sa-south1?
carmen: ops-flags show nightly reclaim and we also enabled kv_compaction.burst for a bench at 02:30 UTC.
storage-oncall: sre-bot alert?
sre-bot: ALERT sa-south1 nvme.meta_write_errors=420/10m across 7 nodes incident=INC-20260620-0551
diego: immediate options: 1) region throttle scrub concurrency->1, 2) pause kv_compaction.burst, 3) annotate hottest nodes to pause scrub, 4) taint nodes to avoid new GPU attaches if needed. prefer non-intrusive first.
mike: agree. cost note: spilling active attaches to us-east would add ~ $1.4k/day egress + churn. keep local mitigations first.
carmen: patching ops-flags: `kv_compaction.burst=false` and setting `sa-south1.scrub_concurrency=1`. rolling restart scrub-controller in 90s.
diego: annotating gnode-801/807/816/825 with `warehouse.redwood/scrub-paused=true`.
(1m)
carmen: scrub-controller rolled. monitoring metrics.
(3m)
sre-bot: NOTE remap_growth rate decreased ~65% after mitigations. attach p95 trending down.
mike: please also flip `scrub-on-attach=false` for region to reduce attach-time IO. Patching now.
(2m)
carmen: attach latencies recovering; no Dedicated attach failures reported. :thumbsup:
ops-lead: ops: notify any Dedicated customers with routes in sa-south1 about a brief degraded attach window.
diego: followups: open STORAGE-922 to collect nvme SMART and firmware history for nodes; RFC draft for remap backpressure/compaction interlock: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/remap-interlock.
mike: hold mitigations for 90m then run a canary: remove scrub-paused on gnode-825 and observe 15m. escalate to firmware rollback only if remap bounce returns.
storage-oncall: incident=INC-20260620-0551 will resolve when meta_write_errors < 50/10m for 30m.
carmen: will update status page and incident channel. thanks team — closing thread after stable window. :white_check_mark:
